author: Scott Manley
description:
"No It's Necessary" just exploded, in what is probably the biggest explosion ever seen on Florida's 'Space Coast'. But it's more than just a fireball and a destroyed rocket, this will have many knock on effects.

NASASpaceflight's live stream caught the disaster and provided the footage for this, consider supporting their work.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jm8wRjD3xVA

title: Blue Origin's Rocket Explosion - How Bad Is It?
